## Working Read

This essay reconciles two inward paths to the same architecture. The Attractors and Teleology line supplies telic fields, constitutional elements, standing, semantics, and temporal continuity. Predictive routing supplies the dynamical bridge: energy routing, perspective, capacity, prediction, and the operation of constituent parts.

The resulting self is a federated loop rather than a single executive. Internal signals are compressed reports, local standing is not executive authority, and no telos becomes sovereign merely because it is predicted or desired. Witness stitches the self through time; capacity enables movement but remains answerable to standing; self-operation is distinct from self-improvement because rest and plurality cannot be reduced to utility.

## Core Claim

The self is a federated, frame-relative loop in which telic orientation, constitutional standing, predictive routing, witness, and capacity must remain coordinated without converting any constituent into permanent fuel.

## Key Ideas

- The self is not one loop but a maintained federation of loops.
- Internal signals are reports about conditions, not automatic commands.
- Local standing does not confer executive sovereignty.
- Telos, intention, purpose, and reason are frame-relative descriptions.
- Context capacity and temporal standing constrain what the self can responsibly do.
- Capacity is the operational bridge, not the sovereign end.
- Self-operation is distinct from self-improvement and preserves non-instrumental standing.
